tagline: Off the interstate, up to the falls, down to the abbey.
intro: Leave I-5 at Delaney Road south of Salem and head east, through Turner and Sublimity, then up Oregon 214 past vineyards and Christmas tree farms into Silver Falls State Park, the largest park in the state system. On a clear day five Cascade peaks show, from Hood to Rainier.
From the park the highway comes down to Silverton, named for Silver Creek, which runs from the falls right through town. Then it bends north through Mt. Angel to Woodburn, 55 miles in all.
season: TripCheck gives spring, for the waterfalls and wildflowers, and fall, for the color, as the best times.

moments.title: Silver Falls State Park
moments.text: A logging town once sat atop South Falls and sold admission to watch cars pushed over the edge, and now the Canyon Trail walks behind four of the park's ten falls.

moments.title: Silverton
moments.text: On the edge of the Willamette Valley, Silverton keeps murals depicting Norman Rockwell's paintings.

moments.title: Mount Angel Abbey
moments.text: Benedictines from Engelberg in Switzerland gave the butte its new name, Mount Angel, and their abbey on its 485-foot top keeps a library designed by Alvar Aalto.

sources.label: ODOT TripCheck, The Silver Falls Scenic Byway
